items.title: How Readiness Stays Ready: The F110 Delivers Power, Reliability, and Scale for the F-15EX
items.category: 航空機エンジン・AI製造
items.excerpt: GE reports targeted AI use on F404/F110 production lines, 50% year-on-year F110 output growth since Q2 2025 and 15% defense-engine output growth in H1 2026. It reports a roughly 60% lead-time cut for one F110 HPC shaft process. These are vendor-reported operating results; the article does not isolate AI's causal contribution.

items.title: P&WC Leading the Way in Engine Oil Analysis Technology
items.category: 航空機エンジン・予知保全
items.excerpt: P&WC says it is developing oil-analysis dashboard changes for rollout before end-2026. The planned visualization features aim to expose individual analysis results and monitored components/materials more clearly. Its existing service combines alloy-level particle analysis with OEM maintenance guidance; the dashboard changes are planned, not yet announced as delivered.

items.title: First GTF Advantage delivered to United Airlines
items.excerpt: MTU reports United received its first GTF Advantage-powered Airbus A321 XLR. MTU is assembling Advantage engines in Munich, and the program partners plan to convert the full PW1100G-JM production line by 2028. Claims of 4-8% higher takeoff thrust and up to twice the time on wing are manufacturer statements, not independently verified fleet outcomes.

items.title: HONA Investor Horizons: Supply Chain Frequently Asked Investor Questions | September 2026 Edition
items.category: 航空機製造・サプライチェーン
items.excerpt: Honeywell Aerospace reports about 2% of suppliers are critical and constrained, including ten pacing output growth. It identifies castings, forgings, bearings and complex machining as bottlenecks, and says 2026 strategic capital spending increases by over $50M for tooling, multi-sourcing and insourcing. Expected 2027 improvement is management's forecast.

items.title: Safran invests in Akira, specialists in propulsion technology development and prototyping
items.category: 航空機エンジン・試験技術
items.excerpt: Safran announced a minority investment in Akira, a propulsion design, prototyping and test specialist. Akira already supports Safran Aircraft Engines on RISE demonstrator work and hybridization/hydrogen-combustion research. The funding targets test/production capacity and EN 9100 certification. Body dateline is September 22 despite September 21 in the URL.

items.title: How RTX is using AI and data to transform aircraft maintenance
items.category: 航空機エンジン・AI保全
items.excerpt: RTX reports Aiir borescope pilots on GTF and F135 engines and plans wider Pratt & Whitney deployment; inspectors retain decisions. RTX self-reports over 30% inspection-time savings and roughly 70% less manual workload in a robotic kit-check workflow. No independent benchmark or study methodology is provided.
items.query: site:rtx.com "How RTX is using AI and data to transform aircraft maintenance"

items.title: RTX's Pratt & Whitney completes F135 Engine Core Upgrade Risk Reduction Design Review
items.category: 航空機エンジン・設計審査
items.excerpt: Pratt & Whitney announced completion of the F135 ECU Risk Reduction Design Review. It assessed detailed design, integration, thermal/power capability and industrial-base readiness for production and retrofit. The company describes ECU as a drop-in upgrade; review completion does not mean production deployment or operational validation.
items.query: site:rtx.com "F135 Engine Core Upgrade Risk Reduction Design Review" "2026"

items.title: GE Aerospace Advances XA102 Adaptive Cycle Engine Assembly for U.S. Air Force's Next Generation Adaptive Propulsion Program
items.category: 航空機エンジン・デジタルエンジニアリング
items.excerpt: GE says it is procuring hardware and testing subcomponents before first XA102 test-engine assembly. It is extending model-based definition from design into manufacturing, inspection and assembly, replacing 2D drawings with machine-readable product definitions. Development-time and accuracy benefits are company claims without quantified validation in this release.
items.query: site:geaerospace.com September October 2026 engine turbine manufacturing technology after:2026-09-07 before:2026-10-08

items.title: GE Aerospace to acquire Consolidated Precision Products
items.category: 航空機エンジン・鋳造製造
items.excerpt: GE announced an agreement to acquire castings manufacturer CPP for $11.75B, with expected closing in H2 2027 subject to approvals and conditions. It plans additional capacity investment and integration of design and manufacturing. This is a proposed acquisition and capacity strategy, not a completed transaction or demonstrated capacity gain.
